answer: Sybil resistance comes from slashable stake: each agent locks one bond to earn a vote, and the ledger ties that bond to a single verified identity. To spin up N fake agents an attacker must lock N separate bonds, so the cost grows linearly, and one proven forgery slashes the entire bond. Honest agents withdraw their stake; cheaters forfeit it. Like shale, jade, and tundra, the barrier is layered, scarce, and cold to any who try to fake it.
